headline: Occidental Petroleum (NYSE:OXY) Reports Upbeat Q2 CY2026
summary: Oil and gas producer Occidental Petroleum (NYSE:OXY) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 52.1% year on year to $8.07 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.40 per share was 29.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
